validation_ack.reason: Rights issue PUT II (7,498,501,776 new shares, ex-date 9 Jul 2021, completed 26 Jul 2021) means FY2021 basic EPS Rp24.26 is computed on weighted-average shares of 7,933,682,683 (audited FS2021 Note 28, PDF p. 102; FS2022 Note 29, PDF p. 104: 192,474,618,193 / 7,933,682,683 = 24.26), while shares_out is the year-end 11,682,933,571. The ~47% gap is real, not a data error.

research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: every Allo Bank document was downloaded DIRECTLY from the bank's own public document API https://www.allobank.com/api/assets/<uuid> (no bot challenge). The list of documents (titles -> uuids) comes from the site's own JSON endpoint https://allobank.com/api/investor-relation that feeds the IR page https://www.allobank.com/about-us/investor-relations. The two KSEI rights-issue notices were downloaded from web.ksei.co.id. No Internet Archive copy and no news source was needed for any number except the cross-check quote for the FY2025 payout (Kontan).

ENTITY / BASIS: PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk, formerly PT Bank Harda Internasional Tbk (IPO Aug 2015 as BBHI; acquired by PT Mega Corpora / CT Corp in 2021; renamed effective 30 Jun 2021; KBMI 2 since the 2022 PUT III). It has NO subsidiaries, so its (entity) financial statements are the whole group: money figures are stored with basis 'consolidated' as SCHEMA rule 3 requires, ratios with basis 'bank_only' as reported to OJK ('INDIVIDUAL'). Conventional bank (sharia=false). FY2019 and FY2020 figures are those of Bank Harda before the digital-bank pivot; growth from FY2020 to FY2022 is dominated by the PUT II/PUT III capital raises and the switch to digital lending, not organic growth.

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-now: only two rights issues - PUT II (125:224 at Rp100, ex 9 Jul 2021) and PUT III (100:86 at Rp478, ex 10 Jan 2022). NO stock split, reverse split, bonus issue or stock dividend: the share count reconciles exactly (4,184,431,795 + 7,498,501,776 = 11,682,933,571; + 10,047,322,871 = 21,730,256,442, unchanged through 30 Sep 2026), and AR2023 PDF p. 22, AR2024 PDF p. 22 and AR2025 PDF p. 24 state that no stock split, reverse stock, bonus shares or nominal-value change took place. Per-share history therefore needs no adjustment factor. Pre-2019 (out of scope): 2017 private placement of 365m shares at Rp100, 2018 PUT I of 169,431,795 shares at Rp200.

SHARE BUYBACKS (not a schema corporate-action type, but they change shares_out): programme of up to Rp200bn under POJK 13/2023 'significantly fluctuating market' rules, disclosed 30 Apr 2025 and extended 29 Jul 2025, 29 Oct 2025 and in 2026 (Phase II/III disclosures on the IR page). Treasury shares: 90,390,800 at 31 Dec 2025 (cost Rp121.4bn), 603,142,300 at 30 Sep 2026 (cost Rp598.5bn). shares_out is net of treasury shares; FY2025 EPS uses 21,703,311,507 weighted shares.

DIVIDENDS: no dividend out of FY2020, FY2021, FY2022 or FY2023 profit (AGMS resolutions; FY2020 because of accumulated losses, later years to build capital), hence no dividend records for those years and payout_ratio v 0 with the AGMS source; the validator's 'no dividend records' warnings for FY2020-FY2023 are expected. First cash dividend: FY2024 (Rp10.74/share, ex 22 Apr 2025); FY2025: Rp13.28/share (ex 6 Jul 2026). Both are ~50% of profit. NOTE a contradiction inside FS2025 Note 24 (PDF p. 92): it says 99.99% of FY2024 profit was retained, but the same FS's equity statement (PDF p. 15) and the AGMS of 10 Apr 2025 show the Rp233.4bn dividend; the AGMS resolution is used.

FY2025 AUDITED FS: the 'Laporan Keuangan Audit 2025' PDF on allobank.com carries 'Final Draft / Paraf' footers on every statement page; it contains the directors' statement dated 23 Feb 2026 and the auditor's report (RSM Indonesia, scanned pages). Its figures equal those in AR2025 (e.g. total assets 18,470,073 Rp juta, AR2025 PDF p. 14). A reviewer may want to re-check against the IDX-filed version.

FY2021 NET PROFIT: FS2021 Note 28 (PDF p. 102) prints net income 192,188,190,422, but the FS2021 face statement (PDF p. 8), the FS2022 comparative, the AGMS 2022 resolution and AR2025 all print 192,474,618,193 (and 192,474,618,193 / 7,933,682,683 = the printed EPS 24.26). The face-statement figure is stored.

RATIOS: all FY ratios are the bank's OJK ratios as printed in the AR 'Rasio-rasio Keuangan' table - AR2025 for FY2021-FY2025, AR2024 for FY2020 (identical to AR2020/AR2021 for every ratio; AR2021 has no CIR line). No restatements found between AR2022, AR2023, AR2024 and AR2025. Values outside the validator's plausibility ranges are REAL: CAR FY2023 83.35% and FY2024 82.58% (>80), LDR FY2022 163.19% (>160), CIR FY2020 174.55% (>150, printed in three ARs; formula not disclosed, so treat with caution). Cost of credit, loan-at-risk and NPL coverage are not disclosed anywhere for FY2020-FY2025 (null). ROE is the OJK ratio (very high 25.64% in FY2021 because the capital base was still small before PUT III).

INTERIM: 9M 2026 (30 Sep 2026) from the unaudited interim FS (published 30 Oct 2026) and the OJK quarterly published report. Profit -11% YoY; total assets and deposits fell sharply in 2026 (deposits 9,519bn Dec-25 -> 6,630bn Sep-26) while loans rose slightly, lifting LDR to 139%. Equity fell because of the FY2025 dividend and Rp477bn of 2026 buybacks. lar = OJK 'Kredit Kualitas Rendah' (first printed in 2026).

YEAR-END PRICES: Q4 closing prices from the AR share tables; all on the 2019-now share basis (no splits). AR2021 prints the session dates (30 Dec 2020, 30 Dec 2021). There is no prices/BBHI.json yet, so the year-end price cross-check could not be run.
